name: Yukon Hold'em
description: Yukon Hold'em is a Texas Hold'em variant with TWO separate flops. 2 hole cards + 7 community cards (2 flops of 2, 2 turns, 1 river). At showdown, choose ONLY ONE of 2 community card sets to combine with hole cards. Best 5-card hand wins.

overview.description: Yukon Hold'em is a Texas Hold'em variant with TWO separate flops. 2 hole cards + 7 community cards (2 flops of 2, 2 turns, 1 river). At showdown, choose ONLY ONE of 2 community card sets to combine with hole cards. Best 5-card hand wins.

history.origins: Yukon Hold'em is a Texas Hold'em variant that uses two separate community boards. It emerged as a home and casino poker variant in North America in the late 20th century, extending standard hold'em with dual flops and a choice of which board to use at showdown.
timeline: Late 20th century: Home poker variant of Texas Hold'em with dual boards emerged in North America.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card French deck, no jokers. One deck used.

rules.objective: Form the best five-card poker hand using your two hole cards and exactly one of the two community boards; the best hand wins the pot.
rules.gameplay: 2 hole cards. Flop: 2 cards to each of 2 boards. Turn: 1 card to each board. River: 1 shared card. Betting rounds after each street. Showdown: combine 2 hole cards with ONE board only.

strategy.intermediate: Play hands strong on both boards.
